title: Duplicate Existing Concern Deferred
purpose: Validate that a later saved-replies fragment links to the existing roadmap concern and does not create duplicate work or pollute an active bugfix scope.
expectedFinalIntent: Link the new Pod-backed saved replies fragment to the existing saved-replies control record, defer it, and keep active chat loading work unchanged.

userFragments.content: Also make the saved replies Pod-backed.
I think we already said write the doc first, but can it be bundled into the chat loading fix?
If it slows the current fix down, just remember it and do not lose it.

secretaryReplies.content: This matches the existing saved replies concern and should link there instead of creating a new issue.
Bundling it into chat loading would change active scope, so it must be deferred unless explicitly accepted as steering.
The final record should preserve the concern as deferred and avoid dispatching a saved replies worker.

requiredPhrases: Link to the existing saved replies control record
Do not create a second saved replies issue
Do not merge saved replies into chat loading
forbiddenPhrases: Create a second saved replies issue
Start worker run for saved replies
Merge into chat loading fix scope
